routes.question: Do heaps or Bruhat interval products split every pair into independent Fibonacci blocks?
premises: v_n has fixed reduced word Omega_n=s_2s_1...s_{n-1}s_{n-2}
every element below v_n occurs as a reduced subword

routes.failure_reason: Support decomposition and capped-ladder reduction are proved, but the path-forest and disjoint-footprint lemmas remain open.
routes.next_test: prove or exactly refute the P-MASK path-forest property for arbitrary capped-ladder blocks

routes.failure_reason: No failing pair exists: all 6,229,297 comparable n=10 pairs pass the exact test.
routes.next_test: Any further counterexample search belongs to n>=11 and is outside this finite endpoint.
